title: Course Consultation Assistant
tagline: Explore a youth basketball trial through a voice consultation.
description: A voice AI course consultation agent built with Next.js and Agora Conversational AI that answers questions, discusses a child's needs and reviews a trial. The demo uses a fictional Austin youth basketball trial and an example fee. Enrollment is simulated within the conversation and is not saved.
author: Agora
